# StayOS

> The operating system for hotel General Managers and associates — a
> mobile-first platform turning fragmented hotel operational data into
> proactive, AI-generated intelligence.

- Prototype/demo monorepo (not production).
- Each feature is a self-contained top-level directory with its own backend,
  frontend, infrastructure, docs, `README.md`, and `AGENTS.md`. This single
  repo-root `llms.txt` is the one index for the whole repo — features do not
  carry their own.
- Features share one PWA origin, one Cognito user pool, one AWS WAF web ACL, and
  one DynamoDB operational data layer. Three static-export Next.js apps are
  served from ONE shared CloudFront distribution: the StayOS shell at `/`
  (unified login + feature launcher), LUMI at `/lumi`, PULSE at `/pulse`. A GM
  signs in once at the shell and both features trust the shared browser session
  (single sign-on). Serverless-first, CloudFormation nested stacks, Python 3.12
  + Next.js, `us-east-1`.

## Apps

- [StayOS shell](stayos-shell/README.md): unified login + feature launcher at
  `/`. Login when unauthenticated, feature grid (LUMI, PULSE) when authenticated.
  Static-export Next.js; consumes the shared `@stayos/auth` module. Agent guide:
  [stayos-shell/AGENTS.md](stayos-shell/AGENTS.md).
- [LUMI](lumi/README.md): Feature 1, built and deployed. Served at `/lumi`. Daily
  AI-generated GM brief (KPIs, VIP arrivals, overbooking risk, OOO rooms) as a
  dashboard + audio brief, plus voice/chat Q&A agents. Agent guide:
  [lumi/AGENTS.md](lumi/AGENTS.md).
- [PULSE](pulse/README.md): Feature 2, built and tested. Served at `/pulse`.
  Real-time tiered (CRITICAL/WARNING/INFO) AI-triaged alerts with closed-loop
  resolution: a DynamoDB Streams rule engine, agentic triage on Amazon Bedrock
  AgentCore Runtime via the shared StayOS Gateway, and dual-channel delivery
  (AppSync Events realtime + Web Push). Deploys with the whole platform via
  `make deploy-all`. Spec:
  [pulse/.kiro/specs/initial-pulse-project/](pulse/.kiro/specs/initial-pulse-project/);
  discovery trail: [pulse/aiplc-docs/](pulse/aiplc-docs/).

## Shared

- [shared/README.md](shared/README.md): the cross-feature shared layer.
- [shared/auth/src/index.ts](shared/auth/src/index.ts): `@stayos/auth` — the
  single client-side auth module shared by the shell, LUMI, and PULSE (Cognito
  sign-in/refresh, JWT decode, and the `localStorage` `stayos.*` session that
  powers SSO). Consumed via a build-time TypeScript path alias.

## Docs

- [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml): StayOS REST API spec — currently the PULSE
  real-time alerts API (LUMI's REST spec is in [lumi/openapi.yaml](lumi/openapi.yaml)).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): root contributor/agent guide — repo-wide safety,
  conventions, and per-feature workflow.
- [stayos-shell/AGENTS.md](stayos-shell/AGENTS.md): StayOS shell agent guide.
- [lumi/AGENTS.md](lumi/AGENTS.md): LUMI-specific agent guide.
- [pulse/AGENTS.md](pulse/AGENTS.md): PULSE-specific agent guide.

## Optional

- [shared/README.md](shared/README.md): the cross-feature shared layer — the
  populated `shared/auth/` module and why the infrastructure carve-out is still
  deferred.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to scope a PR to one feature.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): notable changes per release (`v1.4` is the only
  release tag to date).
